questions.question: In David's psalm about the fool, what does the fool say in his heart about God?

answers.text: That God is on his side
That God owes him a favor

questions.question: In David's psalm, when the LORD looks down from heaven on the sons of men, what is He looking for?

answers.text: Anyone who understands and seeks God
Anyone strong enough to fight for Him
Anyone who brings Him the best gifts
